title: AtlasCare outbound account scratchpad
content:
Context / quick summary:
- AtlasCare = mid-market EHR-adjacent vendor serving ambulatory clinics (primary care + specialty). ~$35M ARR, 120 employees. Rapid growth in last 18 months after Series B. HQ Boston.
- Why we care: potential channel + anchor customer for Private offering (HIPAA requirement + data residency) and Dedicated (predictable latency for clinical decision tools).
- Hypothesis: Their current inference is slow/expensive for real-time chart summarization + triage routing; likely using cloud endpoints with higher per-token cost. Opportunity to pitch cost predictability + latency SLOs + private deployment for PHI.

Primary goals for outreach:
- Get intro to Head of Platform / VP Engineering (primary technical champion)
- Validate current inference pain: latency at 90th, costs, model lifecycle pain (rollouts/failures)
- Discuss pilot: 6-8 week technical pilot with Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated trial; focus on 1 workflow (chart summarization for telehealth visits)

Stakeholder map (guesses, confirm):
- CTO: Dr. Elena Park (strategic sign-off, compliance risk owner)
- Head of Platform: Marcus Lee (day-to-day infra, interested in predictable throughput)
- Director Clinical Informatics: Sarah Nguyen (problem owner for summarization/triage accuracy)
- Security/Compliance: Legal & Security Manager (unknown name) — will need SOC2/HIPAA proof points + KMS/HSM options
- Product: Head of Product, Clinical UX (influence on ROI story)

Technical fit assumptions to test on first call:
- Current models: likely mix of third-party APIs + some internal fine-tuned models. Ask for model names/weights or whether they use hosted LLMs (OpenAI/Azure)
- Throughput: batch offline processing + some synchronous endpoints for clinician UI (95th percentile latency needs <250ms ideally for inline summarization)
- Data residency: all PHI must stay in customer VPC/region => Redwood Private or dedicated VPC required
- SRE ops: Want predictable scaling, metrics, and easier rollouts than they have now

Initial outbound email draft (short):
Subject: Reduce inference latency & PHI risk for AtlasCare clinical summaries
Hi Marcus —
I’m Aisha on the Redwood Inference GTM team. We help health‑tech teams run LLM-powered features with predictable latency and cloud/VPC deployment options that meet HIPAA needs.
We’ve helped similar ambulatory platforms cut per‑session inference cost by ~40% and drop 95th-percentile latency from ~700ms to <200ms by combining dedicated capacity + KV caching and runtime optimizations.
Would you be open to a 20‑minute intro next week to share a quick cost/latency sketch for your clinical summarization use case?
Thanks,
Aisha

Call script / discovery checklist (20 min):
1) 2 min - quick intros + background on AtlasCare use cases (where LLMs used today)
2) 5 min - what’s the biggest pain: cost, latency, versioning regressions, compliance?
3) 5 min - traffic patterns: qps, typical seq len, synchronous vs async workflows, spike behavior
4) 4 min - security/compliance requirements (HIPAA, region, KMS/HSM needs)
5) 3 min - internal rollout process / how do you test model regressions?
6) Next steps: agree pilot scope, stakeholders for technical kickoff

Objection handling (expected):
- "We’re already on X provider (OpenAI/Azure)." -> Acknowledge convenience; pivot to cost predictability, private deployment, and ability to run compatible open models with consistent latency. Emphasize can be hybrid (fall back to hosted). Ask: what are your current token/month costs?
- "We can’t host PHI in any vendor-managed service." -> Redwood Private offering can run in customer VPC/on-prem with our control plane optionally air-gapped; KMS/HSM integration available. Offer redlines we typically see in BAAs.
- "Too much engineering lift to migrate." -> Propose narrow pilot on one endpoint (summarization), we provide migration guide, config suggestions (quantization/batching), and SRE support. Estimated ~2-3 sprint engineering effort.
- "Pricing unclear / cost concerns." -> Offer a fixed-price pilot or short Dedicated trial with committed baseline + transparent token-level billing; show example TCO sheet.

Pilot proposal (quick sketch to iterate):
Scope: Ingest telehealth visit transcripts -> produce structured summary and problem list. Integrate into clinician UI via a single API route.
Timeline: 6–8 weeks. Week 0: kickoff + data access/PII controls. Week 1–2: baseline metrics (latency/cost) + config tuning. Weeks 3–6: roll pilot & compare.
Deliverables: latency report, cost comparison, rollout checklist, quality regression tests (sample prompts + evals)
Success metrics: 95th pctl latency <250ms for sync path, per-session inference cost down >=30%, summary accuracy on agreed eval set within +/- 3% of baseline human labels
Pricing/Commercial ask: 3-month Dedicated baseline at reduced pilot rate (TBD). Will discuss discounts if commit to Dedicated annual thereafter.

Open questions I need answered before cadencing outreach:
- Who is currently the platform lead (email)? Marcus Lee is a guess — need confirm
- Are they encrypting at rest with customer KMS? Which cloud region?
- Current monthly token volumes on the summarization endpoint?
- Any BAAs already in place with their current vendors? Which clauses were sticking points?
- Are any parts of the UI latency budget <150ms?

Notes from quick public research (to verify on call):
- Job postings show they recently hired a Head of ML Ops (suggests rising infra focus)
- Blog post (Sept 2025) about "automated visit notes" — likely early adopter of LLM features
- Funding: Series B announce Nov 2024; growth target to expand into specialty clinics in 2026

Risks / friction points to watch:
- Legal may require on-prem for any PHI handling — need to know appetite for Private/on-prem installs
- Their product team may be conservative on any change that touches clinician workflow due to safety concerns
- If they already benchmarked open models and prefer seameless hosted vendor, price-only pitch won't win

Immediate next actions (for me):
- Find accurate contact for Head of Platform (Marcus guess). LinkedIn search + Tom to intro if network exists. (Tom to check: former colleague at MedLoop?)
- Build 1-page pilot TCO (compare current host -> Redwood Dedicated/Private). Use template GT-TCO-2025. (Priya own)
- Prepare short HIPAA one-pager + typical BAA redlines (legal).
- Draft tailored demo flow: anonymized transcript -> Redwood route -> UI integration (20min demo script).

Slack TODOs:
- @Tom: drop any AtlasCare contacts you have in #partners channel
- @Priya: please draft TCO sheet by Friday (include throughput assumptions: 50 qps peak, avg seq len 1200 tokens)
- @Legal: start BAA checklist for AtlasCare pilot (need KMS/HSM notes)

Personal notes: keep outreach informal at first; reference their blog post to show research. Avoid heavy deck until we confirm platform lead + interest. Emphasize we can run pilot without moving PHI outside their VPC.

-- end scratchpad --
